task: Task 6 — publish + sub-loops + MCP-stdio attestation + just-retry recovery
summary: All three round-1 findings resolved correctly. The two-location auto-mode token binding is now functional end-to-end: a new sops key, deploy.yml mapping, and blogger.env.j2 render add PUBLISH_AUTO_MODE_TOKEN_CONFIRM, and the template comment documents the two-edit requirement clearly. notify_pending is correctly removed from publishing→published with a comment explaining why, and a new test assertion pins the invariant. The archive docstring note is clear and actionable.

T6-1.verified: Four coordinated changes: (1) secrets.sops.yml.template adds publish_auto_mode_token_confirm with documentation; (2) deploy.yml pre_tasks set_fact adds vault_publish_auto_mode_token_confirm from sops; (3) deploy.yml Phase 7.5 vars passes publish_auto_mode_token_confirm to the role; (4) blogger.env.j2 renders PUBLISH_AUTO_MODE_TOKEN_CONFIRM from that var. main.py's PUBLISH_AUTO_MODE_TOKEN_CONFIRM env var lookup will now find the value at deploy time. The two-location binding requires two separate sops keys to be set identically — a single stale edit cannot re-enable auto-mode.

Comment documents the user-spec step 9 requirement and the delegation to attest.py. test_publish_handlers.py adds 'assert refreshed.notify_pending is False' on the success path with an inline comment explaining the invariant.

informational_notes.title: Two-location binding: operator must set SAME value in both sops keys
informational_notes.description: The new design requires publish_auto_mode_token and publish_auto_mode_token_confirm to carry identical values ('Set the SAME value into both keys via separate sops edits'). This means the two-location binding guards against single-edit accidents, not against a determined operator setting both keys to any shared value. The README runbook in the content-publisher role (Task 3) should document this procedure — Task 3's README currently only documents PUBLISH_AUTO_MODE_TOKEN. Worth adding a note there in a follow-up. Not blocking.
